15. **Infrastructure and policing.** Roads and relay stations with upkeep, which speed messages and orders but also invading armies (the roads term in the pace rule, "What sets a company's pace"), can be captured or cut, and can be built jointly with a neighbour under a sealed tablet (who pays what is on the tablet and only words, and a road belongs to whoever holds the land it crosses: "A road belongs to the land it crosses"), though messages passing a neighbour's stations may be read there (the later layer of "Distance inside your own realm"); and policing, patrols and garrisons whose cost holds banditry and piracy down and catches smugglers at the borders ("Pirates and bandits", "Tolls and smuggling"). Depends on item 13. Walls, roads, harbours and water works start as the sources give them ("Starting positions come from the sources"), city by city and the capitals included, so Akhetaten starts without a city wall, Egypt's defence being its distance, the Sinai and its forts at the Delta and in Nubia, raised as the walls dossier gives them, while Qatna and Qadesh are among the strongest places (decided 29 October 2026, answering the walls dossier's review point; Haakon: "Yes to all, expertly!"), and water works are built like walls ("Water too"). Walls may be repaired under siege at their real cost, in men from the defence, food from the stores and what the city holds, in place of item 5's ban ("Walls price the storm, not the clock"; decided 28 October 2026). Policing acts on the outlaws of item 11 along the routes and interception of item 7. It reaches only where the king's men can go (decided 29 October 2026): inside the walls of a besieged city and no further, and nowhere hostile troops stand, so it never catches an enemy's smugglers or supply caravans in land his armies hold. Everything built follows one rule, a level with upkeep, decay and projects that take seasons ("One rule for everything built"), each paid in gold or in labour ("Paid in gold or in labour"): this item builds it for roads, relay stations, policing and harbours and brings item 5's walls into it, and the economy's later phases add fields, mines and storage through it. **Stop for review.**
